schema_note: Phase 1D-D-t D3 frame-mapping inventory v1.0. Companion to reports/phase1d_d_t_d3_frame_mapping_audit.md. Formal conclusion objects carry the seven mandatory fields (classification, source, assumptions, derivation_summary, convention_dependencies, implementation_consequence, evidence_needed_to_change_status). Records without a 'classification' key are reference/metadata records, not conclusions. Signature (-,+,+,+) unless stated.

frame_transformation_derivation_steps: 1. declare xi^a := u_destination^a-u_source^a and decompose T^(i) w.r.t. arbitrary observer n (explicit source-to-destination boost table, report Sec. 9; DBE (15)/BDE (14)-(15) source-oriented anchors reconciled)
2. derive the linear commutator h(D f)dot = D fdot + fdot a - (Theta/3) D f (coordinate check C1)

3. assemble Dcaldot^(i) from gradient of energy conservation + commutator + momentum equation => GM (2.14) for ARBITRARY admissible n (symbol check S1; coordinate check C4 proves it from raw conservation with arbitrary gauge AND arbitrary observer velocity)

4. frame-shift laws for each variable (C6a-C6e): Delta shift -a Theta (1+w) xi; P shift -a Theta c^2 xi; closure combination exactly frame-invariant at first order (C6e) -- the c_s^2 reshuffling feared in 1D-C cancels within first-order perturbation theory
5. specialise n = u_d: dust geodesic (C5) => F^(eff) = -(1/a) P^(eff) => (4.6) with +Theta(1+w)P^(eff)
6. scalarise (BDE (63)) and use BDE (74), footnotes 21-22, plus GM footnote 8 to go to frequency space with Vtilde/Ptilde rescaling => printed (4.10) exactly (S2)
7. impose the closure combination that is frame-invariant at first order, Eq. (4.13), => self-coupling (w_eff - c_s(eff)^2) Theta with no extra terms (S3)
